title: Senior Navy sources say the greys' genetic collection has ended
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Senior Navy sources say the greys' genetic collection has ended, about recent at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But, I've heard from some pretty senior, you know, impressive people in uh the Navy that like that might be real and like that that uh genetic collection on the part of these grays just ended.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he has heard from some senior and impressive people in the US Navy that the greys may be real. The greys are the small grey-skinned beings described in many alien abduction stories. According to Michels, these Navy people say the greys were collecting human genetic material, and that this collection has now ended, which would mean the abductions people report were real and have stopped.
